description: The minimum node graph for any app page — what POST .../application/{app}/page returns before a single widget is added. 3 real structural nodes; draft-envelope bookkeeping (Root, CurrentVersion, PublishedBy, _meta_version) sits alongside them but is not itself wire knowledge to construct.
notes: On the real wire the root Body container is conventionally literally named "Container001" (and its Style "Style001") rather than a random id — every widget shape in this pack references that literal id as an assumed pre-existing parent rather than re-minting it.
API create (POST .../application/{app}/page) does NOT touch app navigation at all — the page exists but no Menu points at it yet; see menu_navigation.json for that separate step.

A page's draft top level also carries Root (the page id, mirroring how a form/process draft carries Root->model id), CurrentVersion, PublishedAt/PublishedBy (an embedded {_id,Name,Kind:"User"} object, not a separately id-keyed node), and _meta_version — all builder/platform bookkeeping the API writes itself, never something a build script constructs.

DELETE on a page returns {"status":"success"} for ANY id including bogus ones, and a deleted page's own draft GET still 200s afterward (storage lingers) — verify deletion only via the page LIST route, never via the delete response or a draft GET.
